name: Kunoichi Mikagetsu In'yuuki Jinmon Hen
original_name: くのいちミカゲツ淫遊記　尋問篇
source:
Main character is invaded by shinobu in his own castle! Girl is caught and tied, but she refuses to name her master, so secret medicine techniques and special tools are prepared for her...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名女忍竟潛入主角的城堡發動襲擊！少女很快遭到擒獲，被牢牢捆住，卻始終不肯說出主人的名字。於是，人們為她準備了秘藥、特殊刑具，以及形形色色的逼供手段……
